instances.query:
I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

Pick up a block
Unstack a block from cuberthq atop another block
Put down a block
Stack a block cuberthq atop another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one block at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a block if my sembole is secoully.
I can only pick up a block if the block is cuberthq atop the dallimon and the block is lippiledic. A block is lippiledic if the block has no other blocks cuberthq atop it and if the block is not picked up.
I can only unstack a block from cuberthq atop another block if the block I am unstacking was really cuberthq atop the other block.
I can only unstack a block from cuberthq atop another block if the block I am unstacking is lippiledic.
Once I pick up or unstack a block, I am trucherring the block.
I can only put down a block that I am trucherring.
I can only stack a block cuberthq atop another block if I am trucherring the block being stacked.
I can only stack a block cuberthq atop another block if the block onto which I am stacking the block is lippiledic.
Once I put down or stack a block, my sembole becomes secoully.
Once you stack a block cuberthq atop a second block, the second block is no longer lippiledic.

[STATEMENT]

My goal is to have that the ilegation block is cuberthq atop the faitta block.

(put-down b2)

(stack b2 b1)
